title: SAE feature bank as Mirror atoms

amendment.reason: Pinned parquet is read directly; pyarrow is installed in the worker container. CPU-only full GPT-2 backward throughput made the planned sample prohibitively slow. Before accessing fresh examples, reduce the screening sample to 8 train, 4 dev, and 8 official-test rows per label. Scoring formula, K/alpha grid, and SHA256 row-selection algorithm remain unchanged; treat this as low-power screening and do not generalize beyond it. Final frozen development and fresh metrics use exact full-model intervention forwards.
amendment.fresh_access_rule: Fresh test rows remain unopened until development freeze.

sample_size_amendment.power_note: Exploratory low-power screen due to CPU-only execution cost; follow-up replication required.

artifact_policy: Raw pinned datasets and model/SAE files are held in the worker cache/artifacts and are not committed. Their source revision, byte counts, and hashes are recorded in the report.
hypothesis: For four related but distinct news-topic steering functions in GPT-2 small, a shared SAE feature bank plus per-topic Givens Mirror coordinates preserves fresh topic-label uplift and limits collateral drift with fewer actual code bytes than independent sparse SAE lists and generic shared low-rank codes.

split_selection.algorithm: stratified sample without replacement within label using SHA256(dataset_revision|split|row_idx|MA-526), then sort by digest

mirror_insertion: Per-topic Givens angles rotate paired coefficients in one shared SAE feature bank before decoding into the layer-8 residual stream.
physical_object: one pinned GPT-2 small model and one pinned layer-8 SAE dictionary shared by all four topic functions
mirror_coordinate: up to eight FP16 per-topic Givens angles (K/2 active adjacent pairs) over paired coefficients in a shared SAE feature atom bank
controls: independent SAE top-K feature steering per topic
shared SAE atom bank with generic per-topic low-rank coefficients
shared SAE atom bank with Givens Mirror angles

development.data: AG News train split; 32 examples per label for fitting and 16 per label for development selection
allowed_selection: development-only Givens angle fitting from zero initialization

fresh.data: AG News official test split; 32 examples per label

feature_selection: For each topic c and SAE feature j, compute S[c,j]=mean_i <grad_h logP(label_c|x_i), D_j> over training examples, where h is the last layer-8 residual and D_j is decoder feature j. Independent SAE selects each class top-K positive scores; shared bank selects K features by total absolute score across topics.
mirror_code: One shared K-vector initialized from pooled training scores; rotate adjacent coefficient pairs with K/2 per-topic FP16 Givens angles. Initialize angles to zero and fit on development only.
generic_shared_lowrank_control: Use the same K SAE atoms and rank K/2 unconstrained per-topic coefficients.
primary_metric: correct-label sequence log-probability uplift on fresh texts under the corresponding oracle topic code

storage.authority: actual serialized file bytes and SHA-256

success_gate: Every fresh topic retains >=90% of independent top-8 SAE uplift, loses <=2 percentage points of label-ranking accuracy, has <=1.10x full-vocabulary KL drift, and uses >=20% fewer incremental code bytes; generic shared low-rank control must not dominate at byte-near cost (within 10%).
failure_gate: Development cannot meet quality/KL/byte gates, or generic/shared low-rank matches or dominates Mirror at byte-near cost; keep fresh sealed.
boundaries: Four AG News topics and one GPT-2/SAE layer only.
Topic ID is supplied; routing is not evaluated.
No LM or SAE fine-tuning; only feature/code selection and development fitting.
Feature steering success does not establish arbitrary behavior capacity.
